🗺️ Map of Tannaim & Amoraim in the Talmud Bavli

An interactive map of hundreds of Tannaim and Amoraim — the sages of the Mishnah and Talmud — showing where they lived, which generation they belonged to, and which Talmud pages they appear on. The dataset currently covers 13 tractates.

This was made with AI and is a work in progress. If you find any errors or have suggestions, please reach out using the feedback form.

How to use

  • Map: hover or tap a dot for a sage's details · tap a ◆ city to see every sage of that academy across the generations.
  • Daf Yomi & pages: the "Daf Yomi" button jumps to today's page, or pick a tractate and page. The map shows every sage cited on that page, and ◀ ▶ step through pages.
  • Sage details: clicking a sage opens a panel with their description and how many times they appear in the Talmud — expand by tractate and click a page to open it.
  • Timeline: drag the slider to a year, or click a generation or historical event. On mobile, the ☰ button opens the menu.

Sources

Talmud text & daf citations — Sefaria.org (William Davidson Edition). Sage biographies, generations & locations — Aaron Hyman, Toldot Tannaim ve’Amoraim, and Seder HaDorot (Tanaim and Amoraim) via Sefaria. Chronology — Heinrich Graetz; Encyclopaedia Judaica. Maps — OpenStreetMap / Esri (modern); Consortium of Ancient World Mappers, Univ. of Iowa (ancient, CC BY 4.0).
